rows.author: I105;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING EDUCATIONAL ASSISTANCE AND BENEFITS TO THE DEPENDENTS OF ALL MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES (AFP), PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE (PNP), BUREAU OF FIRE PROTECTION (BFP), BUREAU OF JAIL MANAGEMENT AND PENOLOGY (BJMP), NATIONAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION (NBI), PHILIPPINE DRUG ENFORCEMENT AGENCY (PDEA), PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD (PCG) AND BUREAU OF CORRECTIONS (BUCOR) WHO ARE KILLED OR PERMANENTLY INCAPACITATED WHILE IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THEIR DUTY OR BY REASON OF THEIR OFFICE OR POSITION
rows.abstract:
Defines “Permanent Incapacity” as physical or mental ill-health or infirmity which is: permanent; prevents a member from pursuing his or her normal employment; and seriously impairs his or her earning capacity.

Provides for the grant of full scholarship to such surviving children, from kindergarten to tertiary level whether baccalaureate, formal or non-formal education or training in a non-exclusive school or institution.

Also extends the grant of educational assistance and benefits to the surviving spouse and if the deceased or disabled personnel is single, his or her qualified dependent siblings may also avail of the benefit.
rows.alias_name: “Uniformed and Law Enforcement Personnel Educational Assistance and Benefits Act of 2017”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2018-09-12

rows.author: I105;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF CLIMATE CHANGE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create the Department of Climate Change which will function as a core for the development, planning, formulating, and executing legislative measures, that will combine the harmful effects of climate change. 

Proposes to create programs and projects that will help the Filipino people adapt to the adverse effect of climate change in terms of public health, infrastructure and agriculture.

Defines several terms among others such as: “Anthropogenic”, “Geographic Information System”; “Gender Mainstreaming”, “Greenhouse Effect/Gases”, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2018-09-12

rows.abstract: Includes the act of point-shaving and game machinations as forms of game-fixing; Prescribes stiffer penalties of imprisonment from three (3) years to twelve (12) years and a fine of not less than One million (P1,000,000.00) to Five million (P5,000,000.00) pesos on the acts of game-fixing; Exempts from prosecution or punishment  any person who voluntarily discloses, testifies, or assist in the prosecution of any offenses of game-fixing.

rows.author: I105;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMULGATE A CONSUMER PRODUCT SAFETY STANDARD FOR EACH DURABLE INFANT OR TODDLER PRODUCT
rows.abstract:
Proposes to prevent unsafe nursery/children´s products from getting to the market by requiring independent testing of all durable infant and toddler products by the Department of Trade.

Enumerates these products intended for use, or that may be reasonably expected to be used, by children under the age of five years, which includes among others:  cribs, toddlers beds/chairs, walkers, carriers strollers, and swings.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WELFARE OF CHILDREN since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I105;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROMOTING THE PHILIPPINE FILM INDUSTRY THROUGH AN ANNUAL FILM QUOTA AND OTHER SUPPORT MEASURES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to promote the local film industry by establishing an annual film quota that requires all theater cinema to exhibit only locally produced movies for a period of twenty-eight (28) days, namely:  from the 1st to 14th of June, and from the 18th to the 31st of December and such additional dates or period as provided in this Act.

Provides that only Filipino films shall be publicly exhibited in all commercial theaters as well as in all theatrical venues operated by the Film Development Council of the Phils., The Cultural Center of the Phils., and the National Commission for the Culture and the Arts, and any such cinematic venues.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2018-09-18

rows.author: H065;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT 9147, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"WILDLIFE RESOURCES CONSERVATION AND PROTECTION ACT\"
rows.abstract:
Declares it unlawful for any person to exploit wildlife resources and their habitats, or undertake the setting up of fishnets (lambat) or similar materials to capture or otherwise take possession of any of the species including race pigeons.

Defines the term “Lambateros” as those who set up nets or “lambats” for the purpose of capturing wildlife species including economically important species such as pigeons and the like.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2018-09-18

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CONSOLIDATED POVERTY DATA COLLECTION SYSTEM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Establishing A Consolidated Poverty Data Collection System
rows.abstract:
Provides a social tool for the formulation and implementation of poverty alleviation and development programs which are specific, targeted and responsive to the basic needs of the poor.

Mandates each local government unit (LGU) to collect primary poverty data at the local level on a regular and synchronized manner at an interval of not longer than every three (3) years for the first six (6) years of the implementation of this Act and annually thereafter.

Allows the LGUs to maintain their own CPDC System database which shall be received and stored by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) to create a national CPDC System databank. The PSA shall undertake measures to ensure the integrity and safety of the gathered information against unnecessary leakage and unauthorized access.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11315 enacted on 2019-04-17

first_reading.recomm: Approval in substitution of House Bills Numbered 4700 and 5588

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENHANCING PROTECTION FOR OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS IN THE CUSTODY OF GOVERNMENT OFFICERS/EMPLOYEES, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT 8042
rows.abstract:
Amends Sec. 8 of R.A. 8042 to include Sec. 8-A, stating that officials or employees of the DOLE, OWWA, or the DFA, or other government agencies that are stationed abroad and proven to be committing the abuses against migrant workers in their custody shall be criminally prosecuted in the Philippines.

Identifies the acts to be penalized such as child abuse, exploitation and discrimination; violence against women and their children; trafficking of persons; sexual harassment/rape and violation of the Magna Carta for Women Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL LOCAL ROADS DEVELOPMENT BUREAU (NLRDB), PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to centralize the efforts and resources required in the development of our local roads by effectively placing in one body, the responsibility of examining, identifying problem areas, and designing a cohesive master plan that equitably and fairly distributes resources among regions, provinces, cities, municipalities, and barangays.

Proposes therefore to create the National Local Roads Development Bureau (NLRDB) under the DPWH to reduce the adverse effects of local political patronage on the country´s road infrastructure, and streamline its overall development.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING AND MODERNIZING THE PRACTICE OF MEDICAL TECHNOLOGY IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER RELATED PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to modernize the practice of medical technology in the Philippines which shall now specifically include molecular and cytogenetic technologies, drug testing, phlebotomy, research, academic work, and other similar activities.

Proposes to establish a Professional Regulatory Board for Medical Technology, and introduces a Code of Professional Ethics for its practice

Seeks to institutionalize a continuing education program for medical technologists/medical laboratory scientists to remain at par with international standards and proficient enough to provide topnotch services to our people.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AND INSTITUTIONALIZING THE SEAL OF GOOD LOCAL GOVERNANCE FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS, AND ALLOCATING FOR THIS PURPOSE THE SEAL OF GOOD LOCAL GOVERNANCE FUND
rows.abstract:
Intends to promote strong and responsive governance among LGUs to further improve performance, accountability, transparency and participation, by recognizing their achievements and progress.

Proposes to institutionalize the awarding of performance-based grants to LGUs that meet and exceed the minimum governance standards, which they may use as supplemental funding for local development projects.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08719

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROFESSIONALIZING THE PRACTICE OF AUDIOLOGY AND CREATING FOR THIS PURPOSE A PROFESSIONAL REGULATORY BOARD OF AUDIOLOGY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, UPGRADING AUDIOLOGIC EDUCATION, INTEGRATING AUDIOLOGISTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to address the need for a regular study on the prevalence, development and causes of hearing-related diseases, impairment, and disabilities and strengthen the practice of Audiology to resolve the grossly insufficient number of audiologists.

Provides for the scope of the practice; prohibition against the unauthorized practice; disclosure of authority to practice; the Professional Regulatory Board; board examinations; registration and licensure; technical panel on education; and professional ethical standards.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPROVING THE DISCLOSURE AND TRANSPARENCY OF THE EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
rows.abstract:
Intends to ensure government´s commitment to disclose timely, complete, and accurate information on fees, taxes, and other mandatory payments by mining, oil and gas companies pertinent to resource extraction to enable evidence-based management.

Aims to address the inability of the country to meet international standards in extractive industry governance by maintaining stringent regulation through the institutionalization of the Philippine Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (PH-EITI).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING PROGRAMS FOR INCARCERATED PARENTS AND THEIR CHILDREN
rows.abstract:
Intends to protect children of incarcerated parents from all forms of neglect and development problems by providing for placement and guardianship options for the minor children, specifying the persons they are allowed to be placed under the care of.

Proposes child-friendly visitation programs for solo parents and children and establishment of special visitation rooms in prison facilities in order to help solo parents raise their children regardless of their circumstances.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WELFARE OF CHILDREN since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE AGE FOR DETERMINING STATUTORY RAPE TO PROVIDE STRONGER PROTECTION FOR CHILDREN, AND AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, ALSO KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract:
Proposes to raise the minimum age of consent to determine statutory rape to below SIXTEEN (16) years of age.

Hopes to address the disparity in the treatment of those persons who are below TWELVE (12) years old and those above TWELVE (12) years old but below SIXTEEN (16) years of age.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I051;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AND INSTITUTIONALIZING LONG-TERM CARE FOR SENIOR CITIZENS, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to provide a National Long-Term Care Program Framework for the Senior Citizens that shall endeavor to help them in improving their total well-being and their full participation in society.

Intends to grant affordable and quality services to the elderly that will alleviate their difficulties.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SENIOR CITIZENS since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I062;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, ALSO KNOWN AS \"AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, UNDER A REORGANIZED DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES\", AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8551
rows.abstract:
Amends Republic Act No. 6975 to allow Senior High School graduates to apply and be recruited into the Philippine National Police, and states that “. . . a new applicant must not be less than EIGHTEEN (18) nor more than thirty (30) years of age.\"

Opens career opportunities for SHS graduates and allow the government to improve recruitment numbers of the PNP which will bring us closer to the target police-to-population ratio, to be responsive to the need for more reliable policemen.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2018-09-18

rows.author: I083;
rows.title_full: AN ACT RECOGNIZING THE OBSERVANCE OF SEPTEMBER 21 OF EVERY YEAR  AS THE NATIONAL DAY OF REMEMBRANCE FOR THE VICTIMS OF MARTIAL LAW, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to recognize the Filipinos who were victims of enforced or involuntary disappearance and other human rights violations committed during the regime of the late former President Ferdinand Marcos.

Seek to solidify the state´s remembrance of the day as it should be remembered which shall be essential in ensuring that the state does not forget its role in the recovery of the nation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2018-09-18

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING LAND, AIR, AND SEA TRANSPORT PROVIDERS TO PROVIDE PRIORITY SEATING FOR THE ELDERLY, FURTHER AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7432, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9257 AND 9994, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE EXPANDED SENIOR CITIZENS ACT OF 2010
rows.abstract:
States that all transport providers shall reserve and designate the best possible seats for senior citizens which shall be clearly labelled to indicate that other passengers may use them but must vacate them if they are needed by an elderly passenger.

Provides that air and sea transport providers shall ensure that priority seats are made available DURING THEIR RESERVATION.

rows.title_full: AN ACT RECOGNIZING FILIPINO CITIZENS BORN ABROAD OF FILIPINO MOTHERS OR FATHERS
rows.abstract:
States that foreign nationals born to Filipino fathers or mothers regardless of their citizenship held, shall be recognized as Filipinos and shall be granted full civil, economic and political rights enjoyed by Filipino citizens and shall be allowed to apply for dual citizenship if they choose.

Mandates the issuance of a Recognition Identification Card by the Bureau of Immigration to prove Filipino citizenship in the same way as Philippine birth certificate.

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR THE URBAN POOR AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER 82 OF 1986, AS AMENDED, WHICH CREATED THE PRESIDENTIAL COMMISSION FOR THE URBAN POOR, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Institutionalizes and strengthens the powers of the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor (PCUP) through the creation of the National Commission for the Urban Poor (NCUP).

Proposes to introduce the following:  1) Social preparations in resettlement and relocation of the urban poor; 2) Amendments to some provisions of R.A.7279 (Urban Development and Housing A Law); and 3) Institutionalization of new programs and activities of the Commission.

Recommends that the Commission be part of inter-agency formation, among others, as follows: 
a)	National Urban Development and Housing Framework;
b)	Identification of Sites for Socialized Housing;
c)	Livelihood projects for Urban Poor Settler Families Fund
d)	Promotion of the concept of “TOWNSHIP” or “RESETTLEMENT SITES” within economic zones, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2018-09-18

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8551, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE REFORM AND REORGANIZATION ACT OF 1998\" AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990\", AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes for the People´s Law Enforcement Board (PLEB) to have jurisdiction to hear and decide cases filed by citizens, against erring members of the PNP.

Grants more authority and independence to the Internal Affairs Service (IAS) as well as the PLEB to strengthen PNP accountability and lessens potential political influence.
 
Enumerates the instances when PLEB shall conduct, motu proprio, automatic investigation of cases involving uniformed and non-uniformed PNP PERSONNEL.
rows.alias_name: “Strengthening the IAS and PLEBs Act of 2017”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2018-09-25

rows.author: I044;I037;I033;C105;I039;H046;G017;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE YOUTH SUICIDE INTERVENTION AND PREVENTION
rows.abstract:
Aims to introduce a Life Planning Education (LPE) in the elementary and secondary education curriculum which shall require lectures and discussion on self and identity; personal, family, community values; communication and interrelationship with others; sexuality and gender roles; among others.

Proposes a Peer Counselling Program to encourage positive mental health for students which aims to teach basic counselling skills; foster relationship and confidence building among the student body; and be a source of skill and academic motivation for them.

Proposes to encourage schools to employ at least one licensed psychologist in order to respond to the mental health care needs of the students, and create suicide prevention programs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2018-09-25

rows.author: I062;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE MAGNA CARTA OF BENEFITS FOR THE OFFICERS AND PERSONNEL OF THE PHILIPPINE DRUG ENFORCEMENT AGENCY
rows.abstract:
Proposes to ensure that PDEA agents are well provided with acceptable living and working conditions; better terms of employment; additional pays and allowances; career opportunities; and proper expert trainings, to alleviate the consequences of the hazards they face in order that they may be able to effectively carry out their mandate.

Provides for the PDEA Academy and its training programs; PERA (P2,000.00); Hazard duty pay (10% - 30% of basic pay); Combat pay (25% of basic pay); Special counsel allowance (P2,500.00); Instructor´s duty pay and various regular allowances and benefits for government workers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DANGEROUS DRUGS since 2018-09-25

rows.author: H025;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7432, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NOS. 9994, 9257 AND 10645 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"AN ACT TO MAXIMIZE THE CONTRIBUTION OF SENIOR CITIZENS TO NATION BUILDING, GRANT BENEFITS AND SPECIAL PRIVILEGES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to promote the mobility of senior citizens to help them take more active roles in society by granting them the privilege to park, free of charge, in all parking lots, structures, and spaces in both government and private institutions.

Provides also for exemption from “unified vehicle volume reduction scheme” among senior citizens who drives they own vehicle.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SENIOR CITIZENS since 2018-09-25

rows.author: H075;G060;I046;G042;I111;H057;H045;G005;I016;F084;I027;I092;G119;H021;I096;H066;I088;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REGULATION AND ORGANIZATION OF ISLAMIC BANKS
rows.title_short: Providing For The Regulation And Organization Of Islamic Banks
rows.abstract:
Refers to the Al-Amanah Islamic Investment Bank of the Philippines, other Islamic banks, designated Islamic banking units of conventional banks, and foreign banks that are authorized to conduct business with the principles of Shari´ah as “Islamic Banks” or “Islamic banking system.”

Grants the Monetary Board the power to authorize the establishment of Islamic banks and the conventional banks to engage in Islamic banking arrangements; and the foreign Islamic banks to establish Islamic banking operations in the Philippines under the The Liberalization of Entry and Operations of Foreign Banks or RA 7721, as amended.
  
Provides neutral tax treatment between Islamic banking transactions and equivalent conventional banking transactions within the provisions of the National Internal Revenue Code of 1997, as amended.

Grants the Bangko Sentral regulatory powers and supervision over the operations of Islamic banks.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11439 enacted on 2019-08-22

rows.author: I094;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 229 AND 230 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991\", AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to address a procedural problem under the Code as regards to the appeal on the assessment of real property or the tax due thereon to the Local Board of Assessment Appeals.
 
Seeks to legislate a period of twelve (12) months from the date of receipt of the appeal to the Central Board of Assessment Appeals, and deletes the provision stating that its decision shall be final and executory and allows parties adversely affected to obtain judicial recourse by means of appeal to the Court of Tax Appeals.

Intends to adjust the number of Hearing Officers to a maximum of seven (7) each for Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, to be determined as the caseload may require.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2018-09-25

(BBSI) A FRANCHISE TO ESTABLISH, OPERATE AND MAINTAIN COMMERCIAL RADIO AND TELEVISION BROADCASTING STATIONS IN REGION V\") - FOR ANOTHER TWENTY-FIVE (25) YEARS FROM THE EFFECTIVITY OF THIS ACT

rows.author: I105;
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO OFFICIALLY RECOGNIZE THE PROVINCE OF BULACAN AS THE \"COOPERATIVE CAPITAL OF THE PHILIPPINES\"
rows.abstract: Justifies the reason for recognition of Bulacan as the Cooperative Capital of the Philippines such that:   It is the province with the greatest number of registered cooperatives and immense amount of combined assets of cooperatives; and also because it has remained in the top five (5) of all success indicators since cooperatives started in the Philippines.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on COOPERATIVES DEVELOPMENT since 2018-09-25

rows.author: I065;
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2018-12-03, transmitted to the Senate on 2018-12-04 and received by the Senate on 2018-12-04
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 141, 142 AND 143 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Intends to increase the tax on alcohol products to approximate the 40-60% sharing of alcohol and tobacco expenditure and to increase its excise tax rate to 10%.

Seeks to remove the distinction on whether fermented liquors are brewed and sold in microbreweries and pubs or in factories for simpler tax administration and provides that tax shall be based on the basis of volume or per liter and no longer on “per proof liter”.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08618

rows.author: G099;
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING  A DATABASE OF PRODUCTS CONTAINING PROBABLE CARCINOGENS
rows.abstract:
Defines the term “carcinogen” as any substance or radiation that is directly involve in the existence of cancer or in the increase of its spread.

Aims to call for government´s action towards a comprehensive cancer control program, initially cancer prevention, which offers the greatest public health potential and the most cost-effective long-term method of cancer control.

Provides that the database shall be available at all health centers and at their website to inform and educate the public about known and probable carcinogens.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2018-09-25

rows.author: G099;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE DISPOSAL OF ELECTRONIC DEVICES AT SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT FACILITIES
rows.abstract:
Refers “Electronic Device” to a desktop or laptop computer, computer monitor, portable computer, cathode ray tube, flat panel television, or cellular phones.

Intends to prohibit the disposal of any electronic device in mixed solid waste; and prohibit Solid Waste Management Facility to accept for disposal or incineration of any such device.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2018-09-25

rows.author: I101;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EFFECTIVE ENFORCEMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL LAWS OF THE PHILIPPINES, AMENDING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE REORGANIZATION AND MODERNIZATION LAW, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Provides that LGUs, DILG, DENR, may, when they deem necessary, call upon PNP, AFP, PCG and the NBI for the enforcement of environmental laws, Eos, and their implementing rules and regulations.

Proposes to create the “Forest and Park Ranger Command” as an integral operations unit of the PNP tasked to enforce the environment laws of the country and of its LGUs, including forest, forestry, and protected areas laws and ordinances.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2018-09-26

rows.author: G054;
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE POLYTECHNIC UNIVERSITY OF THE PHILIPPINES AS THE NATIONAL POLYTECHNIC UNIVERSITY, STRENGTHENING IT FOR THE PURPOSE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Aims to strengthen and elevate PUP as an institution empowered and committed in producing country´s future industry leaders and professionals towards nation-building and national development.

Intends to raise the level of other polytechnic SUCs and serve National PUP as their guide in developing professional and technical course offerings that are responsive to local and international demand.

rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE SALARIES OF EMPLOYEES OF THE COMMISSION ON ELECTIONS
rows.abstract:
Proposes to increase the salary grades of field COMELEC employees such as Contested Ballot Box Custodians; Election Assistants; Election Officers and Field Officers (within and outside the NCR); Election Precincts Analysts; Regional Election Attorney; and Provincial Elections Supervisors.

Aims to reclassifies and upgrades all remaining rank and file plantilla positions in the main and field offices, including casual employees.

rows.author: I105;
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING RETIREMENT, SURVIVORSHIP, AND OTHER BENEFITS TO THE BRANCH CLERKS OF COURT OF THE REGIONAL TRIAL COURTS AND THE CLERKS AND ASSISTANT CLERKS OF COURT OF THE OFFICE OF THE CLERK OF COURT OF THE REGIONAL TRIAL COURTS, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Specifies the persons covered such as the Branch Clerks of Court of the RTC and 
Clerks and Assistant Clerks of Court of the RTC:

a) who have reached the compulsory retirement age of sixty-five (65) years;
b) who have reached the optional retirement age of sixty (60) years; and
c) who have resigned due to partial or permanent disability.

States that in all instances, the employee must be a lawyer who has rendered a total of at least fifteen (15) years of service in the RTC or in any branch of government, or both, with the last five (5) years of service being continuously rendered in the RTC.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2018-10-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROTECTION OF FINANCIAL CONSUMERS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to recognize the role of financial regulators in ensuring that the rights of each and every consumer are protected.

Provides therefore, among others, financial regulators such as the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, Insurance Commission and the Securities and Exchange Commission, rulemaking, surveillance and inspection, market monitoring, and enforcement powers relative to consumer protection

Defines Investment Adviser as any person who, engages in the business of advising others, as to the value of investment products or as to the advisability of investing in, purchasing, or selling
investment products, or who issues or promulgates analyses or reports concerning investment products, with several exclusions thereon.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09054
